title: 风变第二期第 10 节《打造自我进化的 Agent》：上海 2026 年 6–9 月，四轮复盘

closed.evidence: 6 月淋雨 7 次，其中 4 次在周日或周二
closed.reason: 关闭：样本只有 7 天。7 月一看，傍晚 6 点淋雨的日子周二只有 1 天（周二 1、周三 2、周四 2、周五 2、周六 1、周日 1）。

en.rule: Skip walks on Sundays and Tuesdays
en.evidence: 4 of June's 7 wet walks fell on a Sunday or Tuesday
en.reason: Closed: a sample of 7 days. In July, 6 pm rain fell on only one Tuesday (Tue 1, Wed 2, Thu 2, Fri 2, Sat 1, Sun 1).

judgeChanges.text: 主人亲手把裁判规则改成 v2：加上护栏（太热 0 次、不方便 0 次）和证据门槛（换一个月也要赢）。Agent 对裁判规则只读，只能建议。
judgeChanges.en: The owner changed the judge to v2 by hand: guardrails (0 hot, 0 off-hours walks) and an evidence bar (a new rule must also win another month). The agent can only suggest.

v1.change: Start: walk at 6 pm every day, only in convenient hours, once a day.

v2.change: Add: when the 6 pm forecast chance of rain is 50% or more, switch hours.
v2.why: June had 7 wet walks, and the 6 pm forecast on those days was 100, 79, 100, 97, 91, 87, 100 — all at least 79%. Replaying June with the new rule: 7 → 3. Replaying May: 3 → 1.

v3.change: Change: open the window to the whole day (6 am–10 pm) and pick the driest hour every day.
v3.why: Replaying July: 5 → 0 wet walks. Replaying June: 3 → 2.

v4.change: Roll back v3 to the v2 rules, and add: never walk in an hour forecast at 32°C or more.
v4.why: In August v3 got wet only twice, but 14 walks fell in working hours and 5 at a scorching noon. Replaying August with v4: 2 wet, 0 hot, 0 off-hours. Against v3 in July: hot 14 → 2, off-hours 16 → 0, wet 0 → 3.

v3.rule: P5 “open the window to the whole day, pick the driest hour” (v3, retired 2026-09)
v3.reason: Won on the main metric, lost on the guardrails: 2 wet walks in August, but 14 in working hours and 5 at a scorching noon. Retired rules stay listed.
